source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source_reported_historical_synonyms: Dalea nana var. carnescens Kearney & Peebles

morphology_source_reported.varietal_diagnosis: var. carnescens: narrower bracts 1.2–2 mm wide, permanently dense spikes with hidden axis, vase-shaped calyx tube 1.6–2.4 mm diameter; var. nana: broad bracts 2–4 mm wide, spikes loosen with axis partially exposed, campanulate calyx tube 2.2–3 mm diameter

habitat_source_reported: Sandy, rocky or gravelly areas, prairies and roadsides; varieties differ in limestone/sand preference
cautions: Varietal distinctions retained and should not be mistaken for universal species characters
Does not establish Hays County occurrence or nativity; do not export to identification scoring without taxon review
